# RoWeave

> RoWeave is a free desktop app for Windows and Mac that splits an Excel sheet into separate workbooks by the values of a column (one file per branch, department or rep) and combines a folder of Excel or CSV reports into one table. Files are processed locally on the computer and never uploaded. No macros, add-ins or Excel installation needed.

## What it does

- Split: pick a column, review the list of files, click Split. Each new workbook keeps the header rows, fonts, fills, borders, column widths, row heights, and number and date formats. Split can also password-protect the new files.
- Combine: takes a folder of reports, picks the right sheet from each workbook, checks that the headers match and stacks the rows into one table, optionally with a column for the source file name.
- CSV to Excel: converts large CSV files to XLSX in chunks, without loading the whole file into memory.
- Before anything runs, RoWeave shows which files will be created and what won't carry over.

## Good to know

- Price: free during the 0.11 beta, every feature, no limits, no sign-up, no ads.
- Systems: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit, x64); Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 or later) on macOS 12.3 or later.
- Formats: opens XLSX, XLSM, XLS, XLSB, CSV, TSV and TXT. Full formatting comes from XLSX/XLSM; from legacy XLS only data, number formats and merged cells; from XLSB only values. Password-protected XLSX, XLSM and XLSB open after entering the password (it is never stored).
- Not carried over: pivot tables, charts, images and macros. Formulas become the values Excel last saved.
- The source file is never changed; results go to a folder the user chooses.
- Interface languages: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Brazilian Portuguese, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.
- Made by one developer. Support: support@roweave.app
